title: Swimlanes and locks: each ticket in one manager's lane, one owner at a time, hand-offs with a note
why: decisions/0180 R2 (rollout item 2; §5 "Every ticket routes to exactly one of the seven middle managers by its domain"; §7 "One owner at a time" and "Sequential hand-offs … with hand-off notes"; #1460: who works what comes from the appendix). The gap 0180 §5 leaves (how a ticket's domain is read, and which lane is which) is filled by who does the work, from the appendix's reporting lines, as reviewed by the session manager (2026-11-26): orders and fulfilment the Customer Service Manager (17 reports there), billing the Accounting Manager (19), an order's payment Customer Service; data, addresses, nations, privacy, the system's own pages and audits the IT Manager (20-25); the marketplace the Sales Director (31, 32); content and design the Editorial Director (26-28); SEO and campaigns the Marketing Director (29, 30); else the Project Manager. Territory still decides the Tier 4 review (§4). One owner per ticket: the existing owner (a person, or one role); a role never takes a person's ticket, and another role's hold lapses after the hour (TeamRunner::mayWork). Hand off to another lane… with a required note, logged, by the lane's manager, an executive above it, or the Founder (Tier 3, §1). Lanes are routing: never in TeamRunner::ruleData, so the decision tree's approval stands (tested: the same fingerprint before and after). Also: live's why column holds 400 characters, so R1's two long tickets kept only their first 400; their full reason goes into goal where it's empty. The before-and-after check is on for this release, as the role-22 fix's proof (#1472).
data_reason: R1's two long Work tickets (the 6:13 jobs; the before-and-after check's false blocks) lost their reason past 400 characters to live's why column (live read of control_gauge_tasks, 2026-11-26); their full reason is written into goal, a TEXT column, only where goal is empty, so nothing a person wrote is touched.

changes.what: Each ticket's lane as a quiet tag beside its type; Lane in the one filter button; ⋯ Hand off to another lane… (the Founder; greyed for others with who may)
Three tickets added once each: the Scheduler bundle, no Undo after an alarm is acknowledged, deadlock detection (R3)
